name: Stencil & Tablet
description: Poster-loud stencil system: bone canvas + black field + seven saturated accents. Stardos Stencil UPPERCASE at massive sizes (540px numerals). Barlow Condensed chrome. Inter body. Rounded tablet cards (22-26px) in color blocks. No shadows. No gradients. Type IS the layout.
